title: Add Python SF tracking: add sf struct fields to gradient.py GradientEntry, implement sf_update() and sf_select() methods matching C implementation (~30 LOC)
close_reason: Adaptive-SF Python port landed per the C source of truth (lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/gradient.c:261-380 + gradient.h:184-194): constants, GradientEntry sf fields (current_sf None=absent -> DEFAULT_SF at select), GradientTable.sf_update (EWMA alpha 1/4 via arithmetic >>2, int8 clamp for C storage parity, consecutive-sample counters, silent no-op on missing/expired neighbor) and GradientTable.sf_select (6-step CCP-16 + post-step-6 floors a-d in order; None on missing entry; persists current_sf). PLUS the parity fix from reviewer pass 1: update() preserves SF state across accepted routing updates mirroring the C save/restore (gradient.c:158-181) — without it every announce/RREP refresh wiped the EWMA/counters/current_sf and defeated the feature. Verification: 92 gradient tests green; mypy + ruff clean; C-vs-Python cross-validation via the C test oracle (routing_dispatch main.c density-threshold + floors a/b/c cases, EWMA convergence, counter resets, util>200 tx-block, load-factor floor) all match, plus a preserve-state regression check. Reviewer (kimi-k3): pass1 correctness found the preserve break (fixed) + counter-wrap divergence (filed project-LICHEN-worker6-zhgy, P3); pass2 security confirmed bounded SF output in [7,12] on every path, keyed-correct preserve, no out-of-range SF; pass3 edge timed out at 10min - self-run (expired-entry no-ops, int8 extremes, all thresholds' strict/gte boundaries, floor ordering, no mutable defaults) - no defects.
